name: Stem Cup with Dragon Pursuing Flaming Jewel
material: porcelain with underglaze cobalt blue and molded decoration
dimensions: Diameter: 13.3 cm (5 1/4 in.); Overall: 11.8 cm (4 5/8 in.)
summary: The stem cup as a porcelain vessel shape was introduced to China by the Mongols from Northeast Asia when they ruled the country in the 14th century.
